title: Architecture of ytterbium selenite nanorods: unlocking structural, optical, magnetic and electrochemical behaviour with boosting performance for supercapacitors

Ytterbium selenite (Yb2Se3O9) was successfully synthesized using a simple coprecipitation technique, resulting in bamboo-like nanorods approximately 110 nm in size.
